designs.title: See you there.
designs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup.
Image 1 is the existing Envitefy front-and-back shirt mockup EDIT TARGET. Keep the small chest logo layout and full studio framing, replace the garment color and ALL back graphics as directed. Image 2 is a supporting compositing insert: exact official lowercase gradient envitefy wordmark. Image 3 is the official e-and-integrated-paper-plane symbol insert. Image 4 is a board of FIVE existing social icons in exact order Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Reddit. The board's dark rectangle is a preview background only, never printed.
Produce one beautiful realistic landscape 1536x1024 premium apparel photograph with two matching complete boxy heavyweight cotton T-shirts, FRONT on left and BACK on right. All collars, sleeves and hems fully visible, ample surrounding space, pale neutral concrete studio backdrop, soft directional shadows, restrained cotton folds that do not cover prints. No models or props. Flat wearable ink graphics, no glow/chrome/3D lettering.
FRONT: preserve a SMALL pocket-size print on wearer's LEFT chest, viewer RIGHT on front shirt: exact supplied official gradient e/airplane symbol above supplied gradient lowercase envitefy wordmark. About 3 inches wide total. Correct original purple-blue gradient, recognizable exact contours, serif font and joined letter pairs; do not independently retype branding. No sewn pocket, rest of front blank.
BACK FOOTER: centered below the new hero artwork, the exact official gradient envitefy wordmark about 5.5 inches wide. Beneath it, a compact clear row of exactly FIVE social icons, equally sized/spaced in original Instagram / Facebook / YouTube / TikTok / Reddit order, then exact "YOU ARE INVITED" in readable bold capitals. Keep entire block comfortably above hem. Brand spelling E-N-V-I-T-E-F-Y. No URL or com. suffix, no handles, no QR/barcode, no filler text, no watermarks or extra slogans.
NEW CONCEPT: SEE YOU THERE.
Both garments are soft washed BUTTER YELLOW, distinct from black, cream or blue.
Back hero: a huge playful ADMISSION TICKET illustration tilted about 5 degrees, centered upper/middle back, about 11 inches wide and 13 inches high, safely inside side seams. Make a thick cherry-red #d82a49 rounded ticket border with semicircle bite notches on left and right at the perforation line. The ticket interior is the same butter-yellow garment color, not a white rectangle. A single cobalt #2140cc dashed perforation rule near the bottom gives it unmistakable ticket character. Main exact slogan within ticket is three giant tightly composed rows "SEE" / "YOU" / "THERE." in custom ultra-heavy broad softly rounded cobalt letters, cherry-red clean offset print-shadows. Give THERE. widest row. All words completely readable and contained within border. A small cherry four-point sparkle may sit in the ticket's blank stub; no extra words, barcodes, dates or numbers. Confident fresh indie-festival merch, crisp optimistic graphic. The ticket is the big graphic, not an orbit or sunburst. Footer's FIVE social icons and YOU ARE INVITED are cherry red, official wordmark stays original blue-purple. Maintain breathing room between ticket and footer and above hem.
